description:
The Moroccanauts:Taht Dar,a team of five passionate members who participated in the NASA Space Apps Challenge.Coming from different cities across Morocco and speaking four languages,we bring together diverse perspectives,skills,and ideas.United by our curiosity and passion for innovation,we believe our differences make us stronger.Together,we turn creativity into solutions and prove that great ideas know no borders!

Five members. Different cities. Different languages. One team. One mission.
